notes: P1 alternatives: #9 and #13 are other colorings of the same 1617 panorama; #10–12 are the second vol. 6 view (after van der Rye). P2: #6 (Janssonius/Van der Hagen) and #15 (Merian) copy the 1617 panorama and are only loosely dated, #16 (1726) is a book plate of uncertain origin; Libalt’s painting chosen instead. #22 is catalogued as a 1793–98 painting but is a colored engraving published by Johann Peter Wolff, copying the older view; skipped. #21 (Alt, ‘about 1820–50’) is too loosely dated. #28 (1876) shows no recognizable part of the city; #26 is a painting of Paris. #36 is dated only ‘before 1947’. P6: #41 is a true general view (from Krak Mound) but apartment blocks fill the foreground; #45 preferred.
